texts.Scholarships_Notify_Body: Open the record to see what to do. Reminder settings are in BarnCRM Settings, Scholarships and Grants.
texts.Scholarships_Notify_Assigned: You have applications to review in {0}
texts.Scholarships_Reminder_Email: This is a reminder that {0} is due {1}. You can send it here: {2}
texts.Scholarships_Error_Generic: Scholarships could not do that. The details are in the Error Log.
texts.Scholarships_Error_NoPermission: You need the Manage Scholarships permission (in Scholarships Admin) to do this.
texts.Scholarships_Assign_NoPanel: Put the API name of a public group with active members in this cycle's Reviewer Panel first.
texts.Scholarships_Award_NotOffered: Only an Offered award can be accepted or declined.
texts.Scholarships_Decide_AmountNeeded: Enter an amount greater than zero.
texts.Scholarships_Export_Range: Choose a From date on or before the To date.
texts.Scholarships_Paid_Held: A condition of this award is still open. Mark it Met or Waived before marking this disbursement Paid.
texts.Scholarships_Portal_Accepted: Thank you. Your award is accepted.
texts.Scholarships_Portal_AlreadyApplied: You have already applied to this cycle. Find it under My Applications.
texts.Scholarships_Portal_Applied: Your application is started. Open its form link under My Applications to answer the questions and add your documents.
texts.Scholarships_Portal_CannotWithdraw: This application has been decided and cannot be withdrawn.
texts.Scholarships_Portal_Closed: This cycle is not taking applications.
texts.Scholarships_Renewal_NoCycle: This program has no Planned or Open cycle to renew into. Add the next cycle first.
texts.Scholarships_Renewal_NotRenewable: Only a renewable award can be renewed. Check Renewable on the award first.
texts.Scholarships_Review_ReasonNeeded: Say briefly why you are stepping aside.
texts.Scholarships_Schedule_Invalid: Choose 1 to 60 payments and a first date. The award must have an amount not yet scheduled.
texts.Scholarships_Home_FirstRunHeading: Set Up Your First Award Program
texts.Scholarships_Home_FirstRunMessage: No award programs yet. Add a program, then open a cycle on it to take applications.
texts.Scholarships_Home_Intro: Applications waiting for your review, cycles taking applications or in review, and disbursements due in the next 30 days.
texts.Scholarships_Home_NoReviews: No applications are waiting for your review.
texts.Scholarships_Home_NoCycles: No cycle is open or in review.
texts.Scholarships_Home_NoDue: No disbursements are due in the next 30 days.
texts.Scholarships_Payment_Paid: Marked Paid. BarnCRM records the payment; it does not send money.
texts.Scholarships_Board_Awarded: Award created. Open it to make the letter.
texts.Scholarships_Review_Saved: Review saved. It counts once you submit it.
texts.Scholarships_Review_Recused: You have stepped aside from this application.
texts.Scholarships_Review_Closed: This application is not open for review, or you have stepped aside.
texts.Scholarships_Review_BlindNote: Blind review: score the application on its answers and files, not on who sent it.
texts.Scholarships_Award_LetterMade: The letter is in this award's Files.
texts.Scholarships_Award_Renewed: A draft renewal application is in the next cycle.
texts.Scholarships_Award_NoPayments: No disbursements yet. Use Build Schedule.
texts.Scholarships_Award_NoRequirements: No conditions or reports. Add them on the Award Requirements list.
